page_title: AUG 3-1 WOL | Augsburg v Wolfsburg 04/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.

90+6' The ball is laid off to Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the left side of the goal and forces Finn Dahmen to make a decent save.
90+3' Andreas Skov Olsen (Wolfsburg) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
90+3' 10:13 – the total goal attempt statistics.
90+2' Mert Komur (Augsburg) works the corner short.

90+2' Kamil Grabara makes a brilliant save! Mert Komur (Augsburg) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the left side of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

90' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
90' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
89' Looks like Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
87' Augsburg are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
84' We are about to witness a subsitution. Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) for Noahkai Banks.
82' A pass by Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

82' Samuel Essende (Augsburg) doesn't hesitate and begins a run towards the opponent's goal. Defenders try to tackle him, but he manages to keep the ball at his feet and pulls the trigger in front of the goal. The strike, though, was not as successful as the solo run and the ball is easily stopped by the keeper.
81' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
81' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner but it's cleared.
80' A pass into the penalty area from Andreas Skov Olsen (Wolfsburg) is intercepted by the defence. It will be a corner kick for Wolfsburg.
80' Wonderful movement by Wolfsburg. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
79' Sandro Wagner decides to make a substitution. Elias Saad will be replaced by Samuel Essende (Augsburg).
78' That will be all from Mattias Svanberg who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg).
74' The attendance is 30000.
71' Augsburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
71' It's time for a substitution. Anton Kade (Augsburg) comes on in place of Dimitrios Giannoulis.
70' Augsburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
69' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Augsburg players look gutted.
69' The Augsburg players halt their celebrations as referee Benjamin Brand makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
67' Mert Komur (Augsburg) receives a well-taken defence-splitting low pass inside the box and scores! His great effort makes its way into the right side of the goal.
67' A quickly taken corner by Augsburg.

65' 3 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Mohamed Amoura, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg), who beats Finn Dahmen with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 3:1.
63' 3 - 0 Goal! Fabian Rieder plays a simple square pass into the feet of Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball inside the left post. 3:0.
61' The corner is swung in but Wolfsburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
60' Wolfsburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
59' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Wolfsburg.

57' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the top right corner. Unfortunately for him, Finn Dahmen makes a great save to stop his effort. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Wolfsburg.

53' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Wolfsburg are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
51' 2 - 0 What a hit! Mert Komur (Augsburg) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot inside the right post. 2:0.
50' The ball is cleared after Mert Komur (Augsburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Vini Souza comes off for Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) is replaced by Andreas Skov Olsen.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Chrislain Matsima (Augsburg) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
44' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Augsburg comes to nothing.
43' Mert Komur (Augsburg) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
41' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.
40' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
39' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benjamin Brand had an easy-decision to make.
38' Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play and Wolfsburg manage to earn a corner.
37' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
35' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag.
34' Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg) is unable to get a good contact on the ball from the corner and heads it well wide of the left post from close range.
33' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
33' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Wolfsburg.

33' OFF THE POST! Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the right post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
31' Mert Komur (Augsburg) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
30' Mert Komur (Augsburg) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.

29' Mert Komur (Augsburg) receives a precise pass inside the box and drills a promising first-time blast towards the middle of the goal. His effort is blocked by Kamil Grabara who dives to keep the ball out. What a save!
27' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
27' Elias Saad (Augsburg) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall. Augsburg have a corner.
25' Elias Saad (Augsburg) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
25' Dangerous play by Vini Souza (Wolfsburg). Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
21' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
18' Benjamin Brand blows for a foul after Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
18' Kamil Grabara (Wolfsburg) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
15' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.

12' Augsburg slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
9' The resulting set piece from Wolfsburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

9' Elias Saad (Augsburg) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Augsburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
6' Benjamin Brand shows a yellow card to Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) for his blatant foul.
6' Augsburg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
6' Benjamin Brand sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
5' Wait! Referee Benjamin Brand has indicated he is going to review the Augsburg goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
3' 1 - 0 What a hit! Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the top left corner. 1:0.
3' Augsburg quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Augsburg will kick the game off.
Benjamin Brand is introduced as the referee for today's match.
